description: The capacity and the reserved table region of the composed builds, computed once for MAX_ENGINES added engines
(ARCHITECTURE.md §3). MAX_ENGINES lives here: no other file hard-codes a machine count. The offsets are from the
payload base (pay = 0x43000000); the tables sit between the registrar runtime (stubs) and the variables window
(bss_off). Descriptors (76 + 5 x MAX_ENGINES), parameter and CC rows (32 bytes x (6 + MAX_ENGINES)), records
(0x60 x MAX_ENGINES) all fit before bss_off. The MACHINES screen marks cover two rows of 7 = 14 machines; marks
past 14 are not drawn (a third row does not fit between the screen edge and the picture).
